user.title: Aisstream Ships
user.description: Connect to AISstream.io to track vessels in an area or a specific fleet by MMSI.

data.min_length_m: Min ship length in metres (0 = all sizes)
data.stale_threshold_hours: Hide vessels not seen for N hours (0 = never hide)

data_description.mmsi_watchlist: Leave blank for area mode. Enter MMSIs to track specific vessels worldwide.

error.invalid_mmsi: One or more MMSI values are invalid. Use comma-separated numbers only.

init.title: Step 1 — Tracking mode
init.description: Enter comma-separated MMSIs to track specific vessels worldwide (fleet mode), or leave blank to track vessels in an area.

data_description.mmsi_watchlist: e.g. 310865000, 311000986 — leave blank for area mode

fleet_mode.title: Step 2 — Fleet mode settings
fleet_mode.description: Tracking specific vessels worldwide. Bounding box and ship type filter are not used in fleet mode.

data.stale_threshold_hours: Hide vessels not seen for N hours (0 = never hide)

data_description.stale_threshold_hours: Set to 0 for vessels in areas with poor AIS coverage (e.g. Persian Gulf)

area_mode.title: Step 2 — Area mode settings
area_mode.description: Tracking all matching vessels within a geographic bounding box.
